decision_conditions: <p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the three years beginning with the date of planning permission ref: 2024/1396. </span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).</span></p>

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">This permission shall be for a limited period of 3 years starting from the date of parent permission ref: 2024/1396 when the use approved shall be discontinued and the building reinstated to its previous use.&nbsp; </span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">REASON: To enable the long term use of the site for office purposes, consistent with policy LP27 of the Hackney Local Plan 2020.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:8pt;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#333333;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The use hereby permitted, in respect of the basement, the three existing access points (the Curtain Road loading bay and the two side entrances on Dereham Place) and the ground floor cloakroom shall only operate between the following hours:</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:8pt;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#333333;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Monday to Wednesday 09:00 to 00:00;&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:8pt;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#333333;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Thursday 09:00 to 01:30;&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:8pt;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#333333;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Friday and Saturday 09:00 to 03:00; and&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:8pt;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#333333;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Sunday 09:00 to 00:00.&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:8pt;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#333333;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Notwithstanding the above, on the Sunday immediately preceding a Bank Holiday Monday and on 31 October (Halloween) the use may operate from 09:00 to 03:00 the following day, and the terminal hour on New Year’s Eve into New Year’s Day shall be 03:00. For the remainder of the venue areas the use hereby permitted may only operate between Sunday to Wednesday 09:00 - 00:00 and Thursday to Saturday 09:00 - 01:30.&nbsp;</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-73aa46c6-7fff-d264-2cec-32f08d5c1bab"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:8pt;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#333333;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">REASON: To protect the amenity of neighbouring residential occupiers.</span></p>
description: Variation of condition 4 (hours of operation) attached to planning permission ref: 2024/1396 (granted on 04/10/2024) for "Temporary use of the existing building (for up to 3 years) as an arts, event and exhibition space (sui generis)".Amendment sought: To amend the hours of operation to 0900 - 0300 hours on Fridays and Saturdays.
